updates.title: Convex optimization dual decomposition and ADMM
updates.summary: Added Lecture 21 - Dual Decomposition to Convex Optimization (CMU, 10-725), covering Fenchel conjugates, dual gradient ascent, distributed dual decomposition, augmented Lagrangian methods, ADMM, and alternating projections.

updates.title: IPMO decision-focused portfolio reading
updates.summary: Added IPMO: Integrated Prediction and Multi-period Portfolio Optimization to Decision-Focused Learning, covering multi-period portfolio optimization, MPC, mirror-descent fixed-point differentiation, and decision-focused training.

updates.title: Convex optimization coordinate descent
updates.summary: Added Lecture 20 - Coordinate Descent to Convex Optimization (CMU, 10-725), covering coordinatewise minima, block coordinate descent algorithm, and proximal update variants.
